title: nephelium distyle
intro: Nephelium distyle, commonly known as the Rambai tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. This plant is native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Nephelium distyle include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant effects.
